mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO home_project.holiday_info ( loc_date, date_name, is_holiday, date_kind ) VALUES
( #{item.locdate}, #{item.dateName}, #{item.isHoliday}, #{item.dateKind} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE date_name = VALUES(date_name), is_holiday = VALUES(is_holiday), date_kind = VALUES(date_kind)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(loc_date, '%Y%m%d') as locdate, date_name as dateName, is_holiday as isHoliday, date_kind as dateKind FROM home_project.holiday_info WHERE loc_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate};
